integrity: The identity is proved by local parity constraints and a complete arc-space trace decomposition. Finite exhaustive checks and transfer checks are cross-checks, not infinite evidence.
scientific_limitations: One pendant leaf at each vertex of a cycle of length at least three; no claim for more general unicyclic graphs or for weak odd colorings. Priority checks are limited to sources actually inspected.
title: Exact strong-odd chromatic polynomial and cubic threshold zero of sunlet graphs
